description_target.target_text: Template stamping: colored pattern (non-0 non-5) gets pasted into every gray(5) connected region

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((hh (rows g)) (ww (cols g))
         (template-cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww))
                           #:when (and (not (= (cell-at g r c) 0)) (not (= (cell-at g r c) 5))))
                          (list r c (cell-at g r c))))
         (tr1 (apply min (map first template-cells)))
         (tc1 (apply min (map second template-cells)))
         (tr2 (apply max (map first template-cells)))
         (tc2 (apply max (map second template-cells)))
         (th (+ 1 (- tr2 tr1)))
         (tw (+ 1 (- tc2 tc1)))
         (visited (make-hash))
         (gray-regions (list))
         (dummy (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
           (when (and (= (cell-at g r c) 5) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
             (let ((cells (list)))
               (let bfs ((q (list (list r c))))
                 (when (not (null? q))
                   (let ((cr (first (car q))) (cc (second (car q))))
                     (cond
                       ((or (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                            (< cr 0) (>= cr hh) (< cc 0) (>= cc ww)
                            (not (= (cell-at g cr cc) 5)))
                        (bfs (cdr q)))
                       (else
                        (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                        (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                        (bfs (append (cdr q) (list (list (- cr 1) cc) (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                   (list cr (- cc 1)) (list cr (+ cc 1))))))))))
               (set! gray-regions (append gray-regions (list cells)))))))
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c)))
    (for ((region gray-regions))
      (let ((rmin (apply min (map first region)))
            (cmin (apply min (map second region))))
        (for* ((dr (range 0 th)) (dc (range 0 tw)))
          (let ((nr (+ rmin dr)) (nc (+ cmin dc)))
            (when (and (>= nr 0) (< nr hh) (>= nc 0) (< nc ww))
              (hash-set! result (list nr nc) (cell-at g (+ tr1 dr) (+ tc1 dc))))))))
    (grid-from-fn hh ww (lambda (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
